purpose.summary: This is a NIST COBOL Compiler Validation System (CCVS) test program (SQ220A) that validates variable-length sequential file I/O. It builds a sequential mass-storage file with mixed 120-character and 151-character records (using RECORD IS VARYING), writes 450 records in a specific pattern, then reads them back and verifies field values including the NEXT RECORD clause behavior.
